# TOPSUN Footwear

> TOPSUN is a premium Indian sports footwear brand engineered by INTELAGROW PVT. LTD. We design, manufacture, and retail high-performance athletic footwear, running shoes, trail runners, and everyday lifestyle sneakers.

## Key Information
- **Website**: https://topsunfootwear.com
- **Brand**: TOPSUN Performance Footwear
- **Parent Company**: INTELAGROW PVT. LTD.
- **Headquarters**: A/90 NSB Road, Raniganj, Searsole Rajbari, Paschim Bardhaman - 713358, West Bengal, India
- **Contact Email**: topsunshoes7@gmail.com
- **WhatsApp Support**: +91 74850 06659
- **Core Technology**: High-density EVA foam midsoles, engineered breathable mesh uppers, non-slip rubber outsoles.
- **Size Range**: UK / Indian sizing (UK 7, UK 8, UK 9, UK 10). True to Size (TTS).
- **Return Policy**: 7-Day Hassle-Free Size Exchange with free reverse courier pickup across all Indian PIN codes.
- **Pricing**: ₹2,000 – ₹2,400 with direct-to-consumer savings (up to 60% off MSRP).

## Product Line
- **TOPSUN Airflex**: Lightweight breathable running shoe with responsive cushioning (Mint Green / Blue)
- **TOPSUN Duro Ridge**: Versatile urban walking sneaker with enhanced lateral support (White / Black / Tan)
- **TOPSUN Sunspark**: Best-selling all-terrain trail runner (White / Grey / Tan / Orange)
- **TOPSUN Duskflex**: Premium comfort running shoe with snug midfoot fit (Black / Peach / Teal)
- **TOPSUN Emberflex**: High-energy street style performance sneaker (White / Grey / Orange)
- **TOPSUN Cloudmax**: Minimalist everyday trainer with multi-surface capability (Light Grey / White)
- **TOPSUN HyperFlow**: Pro-tier performance marathon shoe with pressure-mapping insole (White / Blue)
